from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
PAGE = ROOT / 'frontend/src/pages/Finanzas.js'
UI = ROOT / 'frontend/src/components/finanzas/FinanzasDecisionPago.jsx'
BACKEND = ROOT / 'backend/modules/finanzas/cuentas_por_pagar.py'


def test_decision_tab_does_not_load_full_cxp():
    src = PAGE.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert "activeTab === 'cxp' ||\n      activeTab === 'decision-pago'" not in src
    assert "(activeTab === 'cxp' || activeTab === 'decision-pago')" not in src
    block = src[src.index('const renderDecisionPago'):src.index('const renderComprobaciones')]
    assert 'cxpData={cxpData}' not in block
    assert 'onActualizar={loadCuentasPorPagar}' not in block


def test_decision_kpis_are_backend_authoritative():
    src = UI.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'cxpData' not in src
    assert 'metrics.' not in src
    for field in ('saldo_cxp', 'comprometido', 'autorizado', 'limite_pago', 'disponible', 'porcentaje_utilizado'):
        assert field in src
    assert "if (!decisionDashboard) return 'No disponible'" in src
    assert 'setRefreshNonce' in src


def test_cxp_list_propagates_current_user_to_factura_dict():
    src = BACKEND.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'def _cxp_listar_canonico(' in src
    assert 'current_user=None' in src
    assert '_cxp_factura_dict(r, current_user)' in src
    endpoint = src[src.index('async def listar_facturas_pendientes'):src.index('@router.get("/resumen")')]
    assert 'current_user,' in endpoint
